tool_calls.command: echo "=== Environment Check ===" && pwd && whoami && java -version 2>&1 && echo "---" && mvn -version 2>&1 && echo "---" && git --version && echo "---" && ls -la /workspace/
apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y openjdk-17-jdk maven git wget unzip curl 2>&1 | tail -20
apt-get install -y openjdk-17-jdk-headless 2>&1 | tail -5
while fuser /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done; echo "Lock released"
dpkg --configure -a 2>&1 | tail -5 && apt-get install -y openjdk-17-jdk-headless 2>&1 | tail -10
kill -9 151 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; while fuser /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done; echo "Lock released"
dpkg --configure -a 2>&1 | tail -5
apt-get install -y openjdk-17-jdk-headless 2>&1 | tail -10
apt-get install -y maven git 2>&1 | tail -10
java -version 2>&1 && echo "---" && mvn -version 2>&1 && echo "---" && git --version
cd /workspace && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/aragozin/jvm-tools.git 2>&1 | tail -5
cd /workspace && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/checkstyle/checkstyle.git 2>&1 | tail -5
ls -la /workspace/jvm-tools/ && echo "---" && cat /workspace/jvm-tools/pom.xml | head -60
cd /workspace/jvm-tools && mvn clean install -DskipTests -q 2>&1 | tail -30
cat /workspace/jvm-tools/pom.xml | grep -A 20 toolchain

mkdir -p /root/.m2 && cat > /root/.m2/toolchains.xml << 'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

    <type>jdk</type>

      <version>1.6</version>

      <jdkHome>/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64</jdkHome>
    </configuration>
  </toolchain>
</toolchains>
EOF
echo "Toolchain configured" && cat /root/.m2/toolchains.xml
cd /workspace/jvm-tools && mvn clean install -DskipTests -q 2>&1 | tail -30
grep -r "toolchain\|version>1.6\|version>8\|OpenJDK\|vendor" /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk-test/pom.xml 2>/dev/null | head -20

cat > /root/.m2/toolchains.xml << 'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<toolchains>
  <toolchain>
    <type>jdk</type>
    <provides>
      <version>1.6</version>
      <vendor>sun</vendor>
    </provides>
    <configuration>
      <jdkHome>/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64</jdkHome>
    </configuration>
  </toolchain>
  <toolchain>
    <type>jdk</type>
    <provides>
      <version>8</version>
      <vendor>OpenJDK</vendor>
    </provides>
    <configuration>
      <jdkHome>/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64</jdkHome>
    </configuration>
  </toolchain>
</toolchains>
EOF
echo "Toolchains updated"
cd /workspace/jvm-tools && mvn clean install -DskipTests -q 2>&1 | tail -30
find /workspace/jvm-tools -name "*.jar" -path "*/target/*" | sort && echo "---" && find /workspace/jvm-tools -name "sjk*.jar" -path "*/target/*" | sort
ls -lh /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar && echo "---" && ls -lh /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk-plus/target/sjk-plus-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar --help 2>&1 | head -40
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar --commands 2>&1
ls -la /workspace/checkstyle/ && echo "---" && cat /workspace/checkstyle/pom.xml | head -80
ls /workspace/checkstyle/src/main/java/com/puppycrawl/tools/checkstyle/ | head -30
mkdir -p /analysis-results && echo "Analysis results directory created"
cd /workspace/checkstyle && mvn compile -DskipTests -q -o 2>&1 | tail -20
cd /workspace/checkstyle && mvn compile -DskipTests -q 2>&1 | tail -20
apt-get install -y openjdk-21-jdk-headless 2>&1 | tail -10
java -version 2>&1 && echo "---" && update-alternatives --list java
update-alternatives --set java /usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64/bin/java 2>&1 && java -version 2>&1
cd /workspace/checkstyle && mvn compile -DskipTests -q 2>&1 | tail -20
find /workspace/checkstyle/target/classes -name "Main.class" 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && find /workspace/checkstyle/target -name "checkstyle-*.jar" 2>/dev/null
find /workspace/checkstyle -name "sun_checks.xml" -o -name "google_checks.xml" 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /workspace/checkstyle && nohup java -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9999 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false -cp target/classes com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.Main -c sun_checks.xml src/main/java > /analysis-results/checkstyle-run.log 2>&1 &
echo "Background PID: $!"
echo $! > /tmp/checkstyle_pid.txt
sleep 5
echo "Process running:"
ps aux | grep checkstyle | grep -v grep
cat /analysis-results/checkstyle-run.log
cd /workspace/checkstyle && mvn dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.outputFile=/tmp/classpath.txt -q 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo "---" && head -1 /tmp/classpath.txt | tr ':' '\n' | head -10

cd /workspace/checkstyle && CP="target/classes:$(cat /tmp/classpath.txt)" && nohup java -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9999 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false -cp "$CP" com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.Main -c sun_checks.xml src/main/java > /analysis-results/checkstyle-run.log 2>&1 &
echo "Background PID: $!"
echo $! > /tmp/checkstyle_pid.txt
sleep 10
echo "Process running:"
ps aux | grep checkstyle | grep -v grep
cat /analysis-results/checkstyle-run.log | head -30

# Run checkstyle on its own source in a loop to keep the process alive for analysis
cd /workspace/checkstyle && CP="target/classes:$(cat /tmp/classpath.txt)" && nohup java -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9999 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false -cp "$CP" com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.Main -c sun_checks.xml src/main/java src/test/java > /analysis-results/checkstyle-run.log 2>&1 &
SJK_PID=$!
echo "Checkstyle PID: $SJK_PID"
echo $SJK_PID > /tmp/checkstyle_pid.txt
sleep 3
# Check if it's still running
ps -p $SJK_PID -o pid,stat,etime,cmd --no-headers 2>/dev/null || echo "Process already finished"

# Use sjk jps to find running JVM processes
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar jps 2>&1

# Run sjk jps with extended output
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar jps -vv 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-jps.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-jps.txt

# Run sjk jps with process details
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar jps -pd "PID MAIN FDQN_MAIN ARGS Djava.version Djava.vm.name XMaxHeapSize xUseG1GC" 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-jps-details.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-jps-details.txt

# Check checkstyle process is still running
ps -p 9531 -o pid,stat,etime,cmd --no-headers 2>/dev/null || echo "Process finished"

# Start a longer-running Maven process (test compile) with JMX enabled
cd /workspace/checkstyle && export MAVEN_OPTS="-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9999 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false -Xmx2g" && nohup mvn test-compile -q > /analysis-results/checkstyle-maven-build.log 2>&1 &
MVN_PID=$!
echo "Maven PID: $MVN_PID"
echo $MVN_PID > /tmp/mvn_pid.txt
sleep 8
# Check if the Maven process is running
ps -p $MVN_PID -o pid,stat,etime --no-headers 2>/dev/null || echo "Maven process finished"
# Find the actual Java process
ps aux | grep -i "java\|maven" | grep -v grep | head -10

# Run sjk jps to identify running JVM processes
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar jps 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-jps.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-jps.txt

# Run sjk hh (Heap Histo) on the checkstyle Maven build process
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar hh -p 9851 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo.txt

# Run sjk ttop (Thread Top) on the checkstyle Maven build process - capture a few snapshots
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar ttop -p 9851 -n 3 -i 1s 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-ttop.txt &
sleep 10
cat /analysis-results/sjk-ttop.txt

# Run sjk ttop with correct options
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar ttop -p 9851 -n 15 -ri 2000 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-ttop.txt &
TTOP_PID=$!
sleep 12
kill $TTOP_PID 2>/dev/null
cat /analysis-results/sjk-ttop.txt

# Run sjk ttop with correct time units
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar ttop -p 9851 -n 15 -ri 2s 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-ttop.txt &
TTOP_PID=$!
sleep 8
kill $TTOP_PID 2>/dev/null
cat /analysis-results/sjk-ttop.txt

# Try using socket connection instead of PID
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar ttop -s localhost:9999 -n 15 -ri 2s 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-ttop.txt &
TTOP_PID=$!
sleep 8
kill $TTOP_PID 2>/dev/null
cat /analysis-results/sjk-ttop.txt

# Check if Maven process is still running
ps aux | grep java | grep -v grep | head -5 && echo "---" && cat /analysis-results/checkstyle-maven-build.log | tail -5

# Start a longer-running checkstyle process with JMX
cd /workspace/checkstyle && CP="target/classes:$(cat /tmp/classpath.txt)" && nohup java -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9090 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false -Xmx1g -cp "$CP" com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.Main -c google_checks.xml src/main/java > /analysis-results/checkstyle-google-run.log 2>&1 &
CS_PID=$!
echo "Checkstyle PID: $CS_PID"
sleep 3
ps -p $CS_PID -o pid,stat,etime --no-headers 2>/dev/null

# Run sjk hh (heap histogram) on the running checkstyle process
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar hh -p 10494 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo-checkstyle.txt
wc -l /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo-checkstyle.txt
head -50 /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo-checkstyle.txt

# Wait a bit longer and try again
sleep 5
ps -p 10494 -o pid,stat,etime --no-headers 2>/dev/null || echo "Process finished"

# Start the CheckstyleRunner with JMX
cd /workspace/checkstyle && CP="target/classes:$(cat /tmp/classpath.txt):/tmp" && nohup java -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9090 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false -Xmx1g -cp "$CP" CheckstyleRunner > /analysis-results/checkstyle-runner.log 2>&1 &
RUNNER_PID=$!
echo "Runner PID: $RUNNER_PID"
echo $RUNNER_PID > /tmp/runner_pid.txt
sleep 8
ps -p $RUNNER_PID -o pid,stat,etime --no-headers 2>/dev/null || echo "Process finished"
cat /analysis-results/checkstyle-runner.log | head -5

cd /workspace/checkstyle && CP="target/classes:$(cat /tmp/classpath.txt):/tmp" && nohup java -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9090 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false -Xmx1g -cp "$CP" CheckstyleRunner2 > /analysis-results/checkstyle-runner2.log 2>&1 &
RUNNER_PID=$!
echo "Runner PID: $RUNNER_PID"
echo $RUNNER_PID > /tmp/runner_pid.txt
sleep 8
ps -p $RUNNER_PID -o pid,stat,etime --no-headers 2>/dev/null || echo "Process finished"
cat /analysis-results/checkstyle-runner2.log | tail -5 && echo "---" && cat /analysis-results/checkstyle-runner2.log | head -3

cd /workspace/checkstyle && CP="target/classes:$(cat /tmp/classpath.txt):/tmp" && nohup java -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9090 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false -Xmx1g -cp "$CP" CheckstyleRunner3 > /analysis-results/checkstyle-runner3.log 2>&1 &
RUNNER_PID=$!
echo "Runner PID: $RUNNER_PID"
echo $RUNNER_PID > /tmp/runner_pid.txt
sleep 8
ps -p $RUNNER_PID -o pid,stat,etime --no-headers 2>/dev/null || echo "Process finished"

# Great! Process is alive. Now run sjk analysis tools on it
# First jps
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar jps 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-jps.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-jps.txt

# Run sjk hh (heap histogram) on the checkstyle process
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar hh -p 11059 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo.txt
wc -l /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo.txt
head -30 /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo.txt
echo "..."
tail -5 /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo.txt

# Run sjk ttop on the checkstyle process using socket connection
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar ttop -s localhost:9090 -n 15 -ri 2s 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-ttop.txt &
TTOP_PID=$!
sleep 8
kill $TTOP_PID 2>/dev/null
cat /analysis-results/sjk-ttop.txt

# Run sjk mx (MBean query) on the checkstyle process
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mx -s localhost:9090 -bn "java.lang:type=Memory" 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-mx-memory.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-mx-memory.txt

# Run sjk mx to query Memory MBean attributes
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mx -s localhost:9090 -b "java.lang:type=Memory" -f HeapMemoryUsage NonHeapMemoryUsage ObjectPendingFinalizationCount -mg 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-mx-memory.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-mx-memory.txt

# Run sjk mx to query various MBeans for the JVM process
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mx -s localhost:9090 -b "java.lang:type=Threading" -f ThreadCount TotalStartedThreadCount PeakThreadCount DaemonThreadCount -mg 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-mx-threading.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-mx-threading.txt

# Run sjk mx to query Runtime MBean
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mx -s localhost:9090 -b "java.lang:type=Runtime" -f Name Uptime StartTime InputArguments VmName VmVersion SpecVersion ClassPath -mg 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-mx-runtime.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-mx-runtime.txt

# Run sjk mx to query Garbage Collection MBeans
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mx -s localhost:9090 -b "java.lang:type=GarbageCollector,name=G1 Young Generation" -f CollectionCount CollectionTime LastGcInfo -mg 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-mx-gc-young.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-mx-gc-young.txt
echo "---"
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mx -s localhost:9090 -b "java.lang:type=GarbageCollector,name=G1 Old Generation" -f CollectionCount CollectionTime -mg 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-mx-gc-old.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-mx-gc-old.txt

# Run sjk mx to query ClassLoading MBean
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mx -s localhost:9090 -b "java.lang:type=ClassLoading" -f LoadedClassCount TotalLoadedClassCount UnloadedClassCount -mg 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-mx-classloading.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-mx-classloading.txt
echo "---"
# Run sjk mx to query Compilation MBean
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mx -s localhost:9090 -b "java.lang:type=Compilation" -f Name TotalCompilationTime -mg 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-mx-compilation.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-mx-compilation.txt
echo "---"
# Run sjk mx to query OperatingSystem MBean
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mx -s localhost:9090 -b "java.lang:type=OperatingSystem" -f Name Version AvailableProcessors SystemCpuLoad ProcessCpuLoad FreePhysicalMemorySize TotalPhysicalMemorySize -mg 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-mx-os.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-mx-os.txt

# Run sjk mxping to verify JMX connection
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mxping -s localhost:9090 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-mxping.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-mxping.txt

# Run sjk gc command to print GC information
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar gc -s localhost:9090 -n 2 -ri 2s 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-gc.txt &
GC_PID=$!
sleep 8
kill $GC_PID 2>/dev/null
cat /analysis-results/sjk-gc.txt

# Run sjk gc command - it doesn't take -n or -ri options, just run it for a few seconds
timeout 10 java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar gc -s localhost:9090 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-gc.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-gc.txt

# Run sjk hh (heap histogram) again - should show more data now
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar hh -p 11059 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo.txt
wc -l /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo.txt
head -30 /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo.txt

# The heap histogram via PID attach only shows the runner. Let's get it via JMX socket
# Run sjk hh with socket connection
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar hh --help 2>&1 | head -30

# Run sjk hh with live option to see the live heap histogram
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar hh -p 11059 --live -n 30 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo-live.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo-live.txt

# The process reaper is a child process. Let's try running hh on the child checkstyle process
# First find all java processes
ps aux | grep java | grep -v grep | head -10

# Get the child checkstyle process PID
ps aux | grep "com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.Main" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}' | head -3

# Run sjk hh on the child checkstyle process (which does the actual analysis)
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar hh -p 13792 --live -n 40 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo-checkstyle-live.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-heap-histo-checkstyle-live.txt

# Run sjk vminfo on the checkstyle child process
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar vminfo --help 2>&1 | head -20

# Run sjk vminfo on the checkstyle child process - dump all info
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar vminfo -p 13792 --sysprops --agentprops --flags --perf 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-vminfo.txt &
VMINFO_PID=$!
sleep 10
kill $VMINFO_PID 2>/dev/null
wc -l /analysis-results/sjk-vminfo.txt
head -50 /analysis-results/sjk-vminfo.txt

# vminfo on the parent process (CheckstyleRunner3) which is still alive
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar vminfo -p 11059 --sysprops --agentprops --flags --perf 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-vminfo.txt &
VMINFO_PID=$!
sleep 10
kill $VMINFO_PID 2>/dev/null
wc -l /analysis-results/sjk-vminfo.txt
head -50 /analysis-results/sjk-vminfo.txt

# Run vminfo with just sysprops and flags (no perf which causes the error)
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar vminfo -p 11059 --sysprops --flags 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-vminfo-sysprops-flags.txt
wc -l /analysis-results/sjk-vminfo-sysprops-flags.txt
echo "=== System Properties ==="
grep -A 100 "System properties" /analysis-results/sjk-vminfo-sysprops-flags.txt | head -30
echo "..."
echo "=== Flags summary ==="
grep -c "Global flags\|= " /analysis-results/sjk-vminfo-sysprops-flags.txt

# Let's check what's in the vminfo output
head -20 /analysis-results/sjk-vminfo-sysprops-flags.txt && echo "..." && tail -20 /analysis-results/sjk-vminfo-sysprops-flags.txt

# Run sjk ttop with contention monitoring enabled on the main checkstyle runner process
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar ttop -s localhost:9090 -n 20 -ri 3s -c 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-ttop-contention.txt &
TTOP_PID=$!
sleep 10
kill $TTOP_PID 2>/dev/null
cat /analysis-results/sjk-ttop-contention.txt

# Run sjk mx to query Memory Pool MBeans - get memory pool info
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mx -s localhost:9090 -b "java.lang:type=MemoryPool,name=G1 Eden Space" -f Usage PeakUsage CollectionUsage -mg 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-mx-mempool-eden.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-mx-mempool-eden.txt
echo "---"
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mx -s localhost:9090 -b "java.lang:type=MemoryPool,name=G1 Old Gen" -f Usage PeakUsage -mg 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-mx-mempool-old.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-mx-mempool-old.txt
echo "---"
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mx -s localhost:9090 -b "java.lang:type=MemoryPool,name=Metaspace" -f Usage PeakUsage -mg 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-mx-mempool-metaspace.txt
cat /analysis-results/sjk-mx-mempool-metaspace.txt

# Run sjk mxdump to dump all MBeans
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mxdump --help 2>&1 | head -30

# Run sjk mxdump to dump all MBeans in JSON format
java -jar /workspace/jvm-tools/sjk/target/sjk-0.24-SNAPSHOT.jar mxdump -s localhost:9090 2>&1 > /analysis-results/sjk-mxdump.txt &
MXDUMP_PID=$!
sleep 10
kill $MXDUMP_PID 2>/dev/null
wc -l /analysis-results/sjk-mxdump.txt
head -50 /analysis-results/sjk-mxdump.txt

# Kill the runner process and create a comprehensive summary
kill 11059 2>/dev/null
sleep 2

# Create a summary of all analysis results
cat > /analysis-results/analysis-summary.txt << 'SUMMARYEOF'
================================================================================
JVM-TOOLS (SJK) ANALYSIS SUMMARY
================================================================================
Tool: jvm-tools (Swiss Java Knife - SJK) from https://github.com/aragozin/jvm-tools
Target Project: checkstyle from https://github.com/checkstyle/checkstyle
Date: $(date)
